text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is running today, right?! I 
can't wait to see that ultimate stride in 
action!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally! She really is a monster... *sigh* 
I'm so glad I got to witness Brian's era 
firsthand~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I heard Mayano Top Gun is running, too! 
Supposedly, she's a huge rising star.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
I'll take pride for the rest of my life... 
in being here to watch this Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, this year's Arima is quite 
exciting as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What everyone expects is either the 
triumphant return of a king at their peak, 
or the emergence of a rising star who will 
topple that king.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I'm counting on you, Narita Brian. On 
that strength of yours."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Who will challenge the strongest 
Umamusume, Brian?" "Will the fierce tide 
of a generational shift continue? Who is 
the strongest Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...The year isn't even over yet. There's 
no point in hyping someone up as 'the 
strongest' right now."
choice_data_list:
I completely understand why you'd feel 
that way, though!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, you're the one who made me 
the strongest. Just be sure you remember 
that."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's claim the final crown of the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown and conquer it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All you need to expect from me is victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...So it's time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I managed to make it in time somehow. For 
the Arima Kinen with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to challenge you as well. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya's gonna beat Brian-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmm~!! You copy!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, she's Mayano Top Gun. This year's 
Kikuka Sho Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"She may still be a rookie, but if you 
look down on her as just a kid, she'll 
pull the rug right out from under you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see... Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to say this to both of you: 
Sis, and Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Come at me. Like you truly mean to 
defeat me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eye copy☆
